Package common

Class Visitor

java.lang.Object
common.Visitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Visitor extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a visitor in the GoNature system.

A visitor can be either a regular visitor or an organized group guide. The class stores identification information, contact information, and role details.

This class implements Serializable so visitor objects can be transferred between the client and server.
Author:
Bolos Saad
